title: T1-T12 AR ROM, transverse sternal fracture, 5 Nm + 50 N (Watkins 2005)
subcategory: long segment with rib cage, stepwise reduction

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: overall T1-T12 rotation range (T1 relative to fixed T12, both directions summed), mean with min-max range of 10 specimens (no SD reported)

source.authors: Watkins R 4th, Watkins R 3rd, Williams L, Ahlbrand S, Garcia R, Karamanian A, Sharp L, Vo C, Hedman T
source.sample: 10 fresh-frozen human C7-L1 thoracic spines with intact rib cage, sternum and intercostal muscles (4 specimens had 2-3 rib fractures, repaired with 1/3 tubular plates before testing)

protocol.summary: Harvested C7-L1 with rib cage, sternum, intercostals, all ligaments and costovertebral joints; potted at C7-T1 and T12-L1 (T12 rigidly fixed to the MTS base). MTS 858 Bionix with universal cradle / x-y table at T1 (free rotation and translation about 2 axes): pure moments 2 Nm in FE (specimen horizontal, rib cage to the side) and LB (rib cage facing down), 5 Nm AR with 50 N axial compressive preload; axial compression 50-500 N. 5 cycles of a 10 s ramp, 5th cycle analysed. Optotrak 3020 array on a T1 pedicle pin = motion of T1 relative to T12. Cumulative steps: intact; transverse sternal fracture at the sternomanubrial junction (intercostals between ribs 2 and 3 disrupted, proximal fragment displaced posteriorly, fragments overlapping); entire rib cage removed by severing the ribs 3 cm lateral to the costovertebral articulations.
how_to_simulate: Model T1-T12 with rib cage, sternum and intercostal muscles; apply the resection of this step (cumulative)
Fix T12; apply pure moment 2 Nm (FE, LB) or 5 Nm with 50 N axial compressive preload (AR) to T1
Report overall T1-T12 rotation range (FE: flexion+extension summed; neutral point not identified in the study)
protocol.notes: Primary PDF read 2026-11-12 (replaces values previously taken from Mannen 2015 Table 3 / Liebsch & Wilke 2022). Values = mean (min-max range) of 10; no SD reported. FE is explicitly overall flexion-extension ('flexion and extension moments were not isolated, and a neutral point was not identified'); LB and AR presumably also full range (both sides) - not stated explicitly. Only data sets with all three conditions were analysed (n per condition not stated; 10 assumed). pct_of_intact = % increase vs intact as printed in Table 1 (equals ratio of printed means). Axial compression displacement (50-500 N: 4.72/5.31/5.95 mm) not extracted into this test.

extraction.from: Results text p.1284 and Table 1 p.1285 (primary)
extraction.check_notes: Read from the primary PDF text layer. Table 1 % increases equal the ratio of printed means (11.24/7.93 = 1.417, 13.17/7.93 = 1.66, 12.61/10.36 = 1.217, 16.04/10.36 = 1.548, 26.59/23.03 = 1.155, 33.60/23.03 = 1.459). Earlier secondary values (FE 11.2 / 13.2, LB 16.0, AR 33.6 deg) agree with the primary to rounding; primary adds min-max ranges for the resection steps and the sternal-fracture LB and AR values.

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (mean as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: rib cage with transverse sternal fracture at the sternomanubrial junction (proximal fragment displaced posteriorly, overlapping fragments; intercostals between ribs 2 and 3 disrupted)

loading.device: MTS 858 Bionix with universal cradle and x-y table; Optotrak 3020

resection.step_name: transverse sternal fracture at the sternomanubrial junction
sequence: transverse sternal fracture at the sternomanubrial junction
rib cage removed: ribs severed 3 cm lateral to the costovertebral articulations (rib stumps with costovertebral/costotransverse joints kept)
